Name: The Pretty Valley Project
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[b][u][size=6]🌸 Pretty Valley The Project 🌸[/size][/u][/b]
[i]One cozy pastel makeover for the whole valley![/i] 🍃🌷
Welcome to Pretty Valley! ✨ This is a complete pastel recolor of Stardew Valley in a single Content Patcher mod. Sage-mint grass, blush-rose dirt, pink beach sand, cherry-blossom trees, a fluffy cloud shipping bin, a flower-covered hippie bus, and a soft pink interface to match. 💕
Everything is image-only, so it never touches your items, NPCs, maps, events or saves. Don't like a part? Switch it off! 🎀
[line]
[heading]🌿 What's Inside[/heading]
[list]
[*]🌱 [b]Nature recolor[/b] – grass, dirt, beach sand and the seasonal outdoor, beach, island and Pelican Town tilesheets, in all four seasons[/*]
[*]🏘️ [b]Pelican Town, fully pastel[/b] – buildings, roofs, fences, the bridge, cobblestone paths and town furniture all match the valley's palette[/*]
[*]🏖️ [b]Pink beach sand[/b] – soft pink sand on the beach and island, no tan patches[/*]
[*]🌳 [b]Trees[/b] – oak, maple, pine, mystic, palm, mushroom and fruit trees[/*]
[*]🌼 [b]Custom-made grass[/b] – hand-recolored grass tufts for every season[/*]
[*]🌸 [b]Wildflower grass[/b] – an optional version dotted with pastel flowers[/*]
[*]🍓 [b]Bushes, crops & flowers[/b] – berry, tea and decorative bushes, plus every crop and flower growth stage[/*]
[*]🪴 [b]Tilled soil[/b] – dry, watered and snowy soil[/*]
[*]☁️ [b]Cloud shipping bin[/b] – a fluffy bunny cloud bin with a matching lid animation (closed and open!), in four seasons[/*]
[*]💌 [b]Magic mailbox[/b] – a sparkly vine-wrapped mailbox, in four seasons[/*]
[*]🚌 [b]Seasonal hippie bus[/b] – a flowering, rainbow-striped bus with a door animation, in four seasons[/*]
[*]🎀 [b]Meadow Cottage UI[/b] – blush-pink menus, buttons, tabs, inventory, toolbar, dialogue boxes, clock and HUD[/*]
[*]🌅 [b]Title screen[/b] – a flowered logo, matching buttons and a sunset backdrop[/*]
[*]📜 [b]Letters & boards[/b] – letters, billboard, bundle page, special orders board and the forge[/*]
[*]🌷 [b]Flower-framed boards[/b] – the calendar, Help Wanted board and Pierre's Special Orders board are dressed in flower garlands, hanging vines and flower clusters (with the Florals option)[/*]
[*]🔨 [b]Custom tools[/b] – flower-trimmed hoe, pickaxe, axe, watering can, fishing rods, pans, trash cans and scythes in every upgrade tier[/*]
[*]🧁 [b]Add-on for other mods[/b] – pastel recolors for Stardew Valley Expanded trees and DaisyNiko's Tilesheets (only active if you have them)[/*]
[/list][heading]🎨 Three Palette Strengths[/heading]
[list]
[*]🤍 [b]Soft[/b] – the gentlest, most muted pastel look[/*]
[*]💗 [b]Medium[/b] – a balanced middle[/*]
[*]💖 [b]Strong[/b] – the full Pretty Valley palette (default)[/*]
[/list]One setting covers the nature recolor and the SVE / DaisyNiko add-on together, so they always match. 💗
[heading]⚙️ Options (everything is ON by default)[/heading]
Set any of these to
[code]false[/code]in
[code]config.json[/code]to switch that part off. If you use Generic Mod Config Menu they also appear in its menu. 🎛️
[table][tr][th]Option[/th]
[th]What it controls[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]Strength[/code][/td]
[td]Soft, Medium or Strong[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]RecolorTerrain[/code][/td]
[td]Grass, dirt, beach sand and the seasonal tilesheets[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]RecolorTrees[/code][/td]
[td]Oak, maple, pine, palm, mushroom, mystic and fruit trees[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]RecolorBushes[/code][/td]
[td]Berry, tea and decorative bushes[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]RecolorCropsAndFlowers[/code][/td]
[td]Crop and flower growth stages[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]WildflowerGrass[/code][/td]
[td]Pastel flowers in the grass (needs
[code]RecolorTerrain[/code]on)[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]RecolorShippingBin[/code][/td]
[td]The cloud bin and its lid animation[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]RecolorMailbox[/code][/td]
[td]The magic mailbox[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]RecolorBus[/code][/td]
[td]The hippie bus and its door animation[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]EnableMenus[/code][/td]
[td]Menu frames, buttons, tabs, tooltips, dialogue boxes, inventory and toolbar[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]EnableHud[/code][/td]
[td]Clock, day panel, energy and health bars, weather icons[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]EnableTitle[/code][/td]
[td]Title screen logo, buttons and backdrop[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]EnableBoards[/code][/td]
[td]Letters, billboard, bundle page, special orders board and forge[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]EnableTools[/code][/td]
[td]Flower-trimmed tools, rods, pans, trash cans and scythes[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]Florals[/code][/td]
[td]Flower and vine trim on frames, letters and the logo (off = clean, plain pink)[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][heading]📦 Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or newer[/*]
[*]Content Patcher 2.5.0 or newer[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded and DaisyNiko's Tilesheets – for the add-on part (each part only runs if that mod is installed)[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu – to change settings in game[/*]
[/list][heading]🛠️ Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Extract the download. You should get a folder called [b][CP] Pretty Valley The Project[/b].[/*]
[*]Put that folder inside
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].[/*]
[*]Start the game through SMAPI and enjoy! 🌷[/*]
[/list][b]Updating:[/b] delete the old folder, then copy in the new one. Please don't merge new files over old ones. [b]Uninstalling:[/b] delete the folder. Nothing is written to your save files. 🧺
[heading]🔁 Replacing My Older Separate Mods[/heading]
This pack replaces all five of my earlier mods. Delete these folders from
[code]Mods[/code]first so nothing is patched twice:
[list]
[*][code][CP] Pretty Valley[/code][/*]
[*][code][CP] Pretty Valley - SVE and DaisyNiko Add-on[/code][/*]
[*][code]PrettyValleyBinAndMailbox[/code][/*]
[*][code][CP] Seasonal Hippie Bus[/code][/*]
[*][code][CP] Meadow Cottage UI[/code][/*]
[/list]A fresh
[code]config.json[/code]is created the first time you run the game. Every option keeps its old name, so you can copy your old values across. The unique ID is new (
[code]NesrynAstraRose.PrettyValleyTheProject[/code]), so any other mod that lists an old ID as a dependency needs updating.
[heading]🤝 Compatibility[/heading]
This mod only edits images. It never changes game data, items, NPCs, maps or events. 💞
[list]
[*][b]Load order:[/b] the nature recolor and the UI run at Early priority, so another mod that edits the same pixels will win. The add-on, bin, mailbox and bus run at Late priority, so they win over other mods.[/*]
[*][b]Inside the pack:[/b] none of the parts edit the same pixels, so they never fight each other.[/*]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded:[/b] in SVE's Galdoran regions, SVE swaps in its own menu frames, HUD and portrait panel, and those take priority over this UI. To see this mod's UI there too, set
[code]DisableGaldoranTheme[/code]to
[code]true[/code]in SVE's config.[/*]
[*][b]Other recolor, UI, tool or portrait mods:[/b] they usually win for the same pixels. Turn off the matching option (for example
[code]EnableTools[/code]) to avoid mixing looks.[/*]
[*][b]Title screen:[/b] this mod supplies a sunset backdrop. Remove other title-screen background mods so they don't fight over it.[/*]
[*][b]Languages:[/b] art that contains text (menus with words, title buttons) is applied only for English. Everything else applies in all languages.[/*]
[/list][heading]🩹 Troubleshooting[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]"FromFile file doesn't exist" in the SMAPI log:[/b] the install is incomplete. Delete the mod folder and copy it in again in full.[/*]
[*][b]Nothing changed in game:[/b] make sure Content Patcher is installed and that Pretty Valley The Project loaded in the SMAPI log with no errors. In the SMAPI console, type
[code]patch summary[/code]to see every patch and why any were skipped.[/*]

[/list][heading]💖 Credits[/heading]
Made with love by [b]Nesryn Astra Rose[/b]. 🌸

Manifest.Name: Pretty Valley The Project
Manifest.Description: The whole Pretty Valley look in one mod: a muted pastel recolor of nature (grass, dirt, beach, trees, bushes, crops), seasonal SVE and DaisyNiko tree and tile recolors, a pastel shipping bin and mailbox, a seasonal hippie bus, and the Meadow Cottage UI. Every part has its own on/off switch.
Manifest.Author: Nesryn Astra Rose
